user.title: Connect to the projector
user.description: Turn on the projector so its network interface is available. Manufacturer and model will be read automatically.

ir.title: Infrared power on
ir.description: Manufacturer: {manufacturer}. Model: {model}. Select a remote entity. Enter the existing command name/code, or choose learning. For Broadlink and Xiaomi IR, use a saved device name such as panasonic_projector. Other remotes may not need this field; leave it empty. Command names are managed by the transmitter integration.

data.ir_device: Saved device name (if required by the transmitter)

learn_start.title: Prepare the original remote
learn_start.description: After pressing Submit, point the original remote at the IR transmitter and press Power On within 30 seconds. This stores a received IR code without transmitting it. Prefer a separate Power On button. A toggle button needs a physical test from standby. Learning the same device/command name may overwrite its existing code.

learn_confirm.title: Check the learning result
learn_confirm.description: The learning request has finished. Some transmitter integrations only report a failure in notifications or logs. Check them and confirm the command was saved. Leave the box unchecked to learn again. The projector has not been switched on by this wizard.

learn_failed.title: Learning failed
learn_failed.description: Check that the selected transmitter is available and supports standard remote.learn_command. Press Submit to prepare another attempt. Close this dialog to cancel.

progress.learning: Point the original remote at the selected transmitter and press Power On. Waiting for the IR code…

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read PJLink state. Turn on the projector and check the address, port and network.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without a URL or port.
error.remote_unavailable: The transmitter is missing, off or unavailable.
error.cannot_learn: The transmitter is unavailable or does not support standard command learning. Use a saved command instead.
error.empty_command: Enter a power-on command name or code.

abort.already_configured: This address and port are already configured.
